description: The five minutes between a self-service page asking for a biometric challenge and the tablet answering it. Consumed on use, so a challenge can never be replayed, and cleared when a new attempt starts. System Manager only: a live row here is a sign-in in progress, and answering its challenge enrols a device for that employee.

fields.description: `assert` when the employee has a device to sign in with, `register` when this is their first time enrolling one.
fields.label: Mode

fields.description: JSON list of credential ids the employee may assert with; a registration leaves it empty.
fields.label: Allowed Credential IDs

name: Employee Self Service Preauth
